units.source_text: 你若不怕损坏名誉，我又有何忌惮？

en.t: If you are not afraid of damaging your reputation, what should I have to fear?
I will certainly find it out.

units.source_text: 难道你想从此瞒住我么？”

en.t: Do you really mean to keep it hidden from me from now on?"

units.source_text: 正在交谈，天色已明，众侍女纷纷起身，赴宫中迎接女御，廊上来往频繁。

en.t: As they were speaking, dawn had already broken; the many waiting women rose one after another to go to the palace and escort the lady, and people were constantly passing along the corridor.

units.source_text: 源氏公子无可奈何，只得和那女子交换了一把扇子，作为凭证，然后匆匆出门，回宫邸去。

en.t: Prince Genji had no choice but to exchange a fan with the woman as a token, then hurried out and returned to his residence.
